steps.body_uz:
O'zbek tilida "soat oltida", "shanba kuni", "iyulda" deymiz. Ingliz tilida esa vaqt turiga qarab uch xil predlog bor:
**at** — aniq vaqt: **at** six o'clock, **at** half past five, **at** midnight, **at** night, **at** the weekend
**on** — kun va sana: **on** Monday, **on** Sunday morning, **on** 5 May, **on** my birthday
**in** — uzunroq vaqt: **in** the morning / afternoon / evening, **in** July, **in** winter, **in** 2025
⚠️ **this, next, last, every, tomorrow, yesterday** oldidan predlog **qo'yilmaydi**: See you **next Monday**. ("on next Monday" — xato!)

steps.title: Dilshod's week
steps.text: Dilshod is a university student in Samarkand. He always gets up at half past six, because his classes start at eight. He usually has bread and tea for breakfast, but he never drinks coffee. He goes to the gym three times a week — on Monday, Wednesday and Friday. He often studies in the library in the evening. At the weekend he sometimes plays football with his friends, and once a month he visits his family in Urgut. He is hardly ever late for his classes!
steps.uz: Dilshod — Samarqanddagi talaba. U har doim olti yarimda turadi, chunki darslari sakkizda boshlanadi. Nonushtaga odatda non va choy ichadi, lekin hech qachon qahva ichmaydi. U haftada uch marta — dushanba, chorshanba va juma kunlari sport zaliga boradi. Kechqurunlari ko'pincha kutubxonada o'qiydi. Dam olish kunlari ba'zan do'stlari bilan futbol o'ynaydi, oyda bir marta esa Urgutdagi oilasini ko'rgani boradi. U darslariga deyarli hech qachon kech qolmaydi!

steps.q: How often does Dilshod go to the gym?
steps.explain_uz: "He goes to the gym three times a week".

steps.body_uz:
**always** 100% → **usually** → **often** → **sometimes** → **hardly ever** → **never** 0%
**Joyi:** asosiy fe'ldan **oldin**: He **usually gets** up at 7. I **never drink** coffee.
Lekin **be** fe'lidan **keyin**: She **is always** late. We **are never** bored.
**How often...?** — "Qanchalik tez-tez?" Javob: **every day**, **once a week** (haftada bir marta), **twice a month** (oyda ikki marta), **three times a year** (yilda uch marta). Bu iboralar odatda gap **oxirida** keladi.
⚠️ "I go usually to school" — xato. To'g'ri: I **usually go** to school.

steps.body_uz:
Sanada **tartib son** ishlatiladi (birinchi, ikkinchi...):
1st **first** · 2nd **second** · 3rd **third** · 4th fourth · 5th **fifth** · 8th **eighth** · 9th **ninth** · 12th **twelfth** · 20th **twentieth** · 21st **twenty-first** · 22nd twenty-second · 30th **thirtieth**
Ko'pchiligi: son + **th**. Qoida buzadiganlar qalin yozilgan.
**Yozamiz:** 21 March · **Aytamiz:** **the twenty-first of March** yoki March the twenty-first.
**Yillar:** 1998 — **nineteen ninety-eight** · 2005 — **two thousand and five** · 2025 — **twenty twenty-five**.
**Predloglar:** **on** 21 March (sana) · **in** March (oy) · **in** 2005 (yil).
Savollar: **What's the date today?** · **When's your birthday?** · **When were you born?** — I was born **in** 2006 / **on** 3 December.
